alex_dev: hi team — newbie here. followed the linux quickstart (export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... && yarn start). first call to /generate returns 403 with body 'workspace_state: onboarding_pending'.
jamie_sdk: can you paste the exact response body and headers? also which sample (javascript or python)?
alex_dev: javascript sample. response: {"status":403, "error":"workspace_state", "detail":"onboarding_pending", "hint":"complete workspace onboarding or use sandbox token"}  no special headers.
tanya_support: thanks. this happens when an org is created via SSO invite but hasn't completed the billing/TOS step. we recently tightened the gate to prevent accidental free-tier abuse.
alex_dev: i didn't realise the UI requires a separate 'activate api' button after signup — UX surprised me. is there any message we can show in the SDK so it's not just raw JSON?
jamie_sdk: agree we should surface a friendlier error. opening DEVEX-1180 to add an SDK error subtype `OnboardingPendingError` with human instructions and a link to docs (https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding).
ci-bot: DEVEX-1180 created by jamie_sdk at 2026-03-23T14:12:00Z
alex_dev: also are there any headers or flags to detect this before making a generate call? would help samples to preflight.
tanya_support: we expose GET /orgs/{id}/status but that's currently not in quickstart. good suggestion to add a preflight check in samples and the CLI. i'll update the support KB and add a one-liner to the README.
jamie_sdk: follow-up: will push a small starter change that catches the onboarding_pending body and prints: 
"Your workspace hasn't completed onboarding. Visit https://app.redwood.ai/onboard to finish or use a sandbox token for local dev."
alex_dev: perfect, thanks. saved my day. :relieved:
